heading: TRUMP ENDORSED
text: “As a dedicated civic leader, public servant, and most importantly as a mother, I understand what’s at stake. We must do everything we can to defend our American way of life. I will fight for the real issues that affect everyday working Americans and together we will MAKE AMERICA GREAT AGAIN! President Trump trusts me to work to lower the cost of living, cut taxes and regulations, and protect affordability for Southwest Florida families! "

heading: Leadership We Can Trust
text: Sydney Gruters is ready to get to work and make a real difference for Florida and our great nation. That’s why national leadership, law enforcement, and local leaders alike trust Sydney Gruters.

heading: Cost-of-living
text: Sydney is ready to cut taxes and fight rising costs so working families can afford gas, groceries, and everyday essentials.

heading: Secure Border
text: Sydney will work with President Trump and ICE to keep our families safe from violent criminals entering our country illegally.

heading: Inflation
text: Sydney will fight rising prices with conservative solutions that help families keep more of what they earn.

heading: Election Security
text: Sydney is ready to fight for Democracy and stand with President Trump to ensure our elections are secure.

heading: Housing Costs
text: Sydney will fight to curb overdevelopment and keep homeownership within reach for working families.

heading: Seniors & Veterans
text: Sydney will strengthen veterans’ benefits and protect Social Security and Medicare so seniors and those who served can retire with security and peace of mind.

heading: Meet Sydney
text: Sydney Gruters, a working mother of three and wife of RNC chairman Joe Gruters, recently served as Vice President of Advancement and Executive Director of the New College Foundation. She previously worked for Congressman Greg Steube as District Director following his election in 2018. A native Floridian, she was appointed by President Donald Trump in 2017 as State Director for Florida and the U.S. Virgin Islands at the U.S. Department of Agriculture, Rural Development. She also spent more than a decade working in Washington, D.C., and Manatee County for Congressman Vern Buchanan.
